For decades, historians have debated whether the Manhattan Project was a scientific triumph or a case study in catastrophic economic arrogance and scientific hubris. This account reconstructs the weapon's development without exploiting analogies to previous conflicts.

Robert Oppenheimer, theoretical physicists debated what energy release could be achieved from splitting a uranium-235 nucleus.
